name: ms-customs-consumption-tax-hotels-tax
description: Montserrat indirect taxes for 2026. Montserrat has no VAT: imports bear customs duty on the customs value and consumption tax on customs value plus duty (Customs Duties and Consumption Tax Act, Cap. 17.05), with domestic producers accounting for consumption tax at production. Covers import entry and valuation (Cap. 17.04), the 50% freight and handling concession from 1 September 2025 to 31 March 2028 (SRO 30/2025), the 5% duty and 5% consumption tax on listed building materials (SRO 31/2025), the 5% CIF processing fee on exemptions, the Business Progressive Fund waiver (SRO 33/2026), the parcels tax, the mined aggregate export duty (EC$2 a ton) and the hotels tax (10% on hotel accommodation, 7% on villas, guest houses and other rentals). Trigger phrases include Montserrat VAT, Montserrat consumption tax, Montserrat import duty, Montserrat hotel tax, ASYCUDA Montserrat.
